chart.what_the_drawing_says: He has flipped from long to short. With price at 60,937.5 he has a short marked from 61,827.0 with a tight stop at 63,342.4 and a very distant target at 48,482.7 — the top of the big grey demand block that spans roughly 44.3k-47.9k. The 68.55-68.77k order block above is now overhead supply. The 'It's time' caption frames this as the moment to take the downside trade.

claims: Sell here like 20% keep taking profits
This monthly candle is special because it's half yearly
indicators: purple dashed level / grey supply band
notes: All prices come from price-axis tags. Line-to-tag assignments were verified by calibrating the axis against the 4,000-unit gridlines (88,000 at the top gridline) and measuring each drawn object's row; the verified matches sat within ~1 pixel (±60 in price). The 68.55-68.77k object measures as a thin band spanning both tags rather than a single line, which is consistent with it being the drawn 'order block' zone. Several tags could not be matched to any line in the visible window and are marked unassigned rather than guessed. 'And I'm completely out' is a statement about his own position with no exchange panel or fill screenshot attached, so it is unverified. The chart's x-axis is cut off by the in-app banner.
